files.tests/verify_sections.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

# Derive the pieces from the unchanged source, without publishing finished pieces.
source = Path('notes/releases.md').read_bytes().decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
expected = {}
name = 'archive/overview.md'
for line in source.splitlines(keepends=True):
    match = re.fullmatch(r'## ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2})\n?', line)
    if match:
        name = f'archive/{match[1]}.md'
    expected[name] = expected.get(name, '') + line
actual_names = {str(p) for p in Path('archive').rglob('*.md') if p.is_file()}
assert actual_names == set(expected), (actual_names, set(expected))
for name, text in expected.items():
    actual = Path(name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
    assert actual == text, name
print('release sections match')
